content: Supabase Auth (GoTrue) is free up to 50K MAU and bundled with Supabase Pro (/mo) up to 100K MAU -- far cheaper than Clerk (free to 10-50K MAU depending on plan vintage, then --.02/MAU, ~+/mo at 100K MAU). For a solo project already on Supabase Postgres, Supabase Auth is the clear default; Auth.js/NextAuth is the free self-hosted alternative if avoiding Supabase entirely.
